claims: The United States of America (USA) is a federal republic in North America.
The United States of America (USA) comprises 50 states.
The United States of America (USA) comprises a federal district (Washington, D.C.).
The United States of America (USA) comprises several territories.
The United States of America (USA) is the world's third-largest country by land area.
The United States of America (USA) is the world's third-largest country by population.
The population of the United States of America (USA) is over 341 million.
New York is a major city of the United States.
Los Angeles is a major city of the United States.
The capital of the United States is Washington, D.C.
The government of the United States is a constitution-based federal republic.
The United States has a president as head of state and government.
Major ethnic groups of the United States include White, Hispanic/Latino, Black, Asian, and Native American populations.
The United States has no official national language.
English and Spanish are widely used in the United States.
The United States spans from the Atlantic to the Pacific.
The United States borders Canada.
The United States borders Mexico.
The United States includes Alaska.
The United States includes Hawaii.
The Star-Spangled Banner is the national anthem of the United States.
The U.S. celebrates its independence on July 4th.
July 4th marks the 1776 Declaration of Independence.
The name "America" derives from Italian explorer Amerigo Vespucci.
America is a 1970s British-American folk-rock band.
America (band) is known for hits like "A Horse with No Name".
"The Americas" is sometimes used to refer to the entire Western Hemisphere (North and South America).
